message.reasoning:
The user wants Cristiano Ronaldo's stats for 2019-2020 season. We have a tool `soccer_stat_get_player_stats`. We'll call it.

We need to provide JSON arguments:

{
    "player_name": "Cristiano Ronaldo",
    "season": "2019/20"
}

But we should confirm if they use slash or hyphen? In earlier examples, they used "2008/09". So let's do "2019/20".

Also optional league can default to all; but maybe specify Premier League? But he played at Juventus then moved to Manchester United mid-season. Actually 2019-2020 season was his first season at Juventus (he joined them after leaving Real Madrid). He didn't play for ManU until 2021. Wait timeline: Ronaldo left Real Madrid in July 2018, signed with Juventus. Then he stayed there through 2019-2020 season. He transferred to ManU in summer 2021. So only Juventus. So we could set league="Serie A", but not necessary.

Thus we'll just pass required fields.

We'll produce the function call.
